instruction.text: How many grams make one kilogram? Choose the correct answer on the right side.

end.text: Well done. 1`kg` has the same weight as 1000`g`. This means that 1`kg` is one thousand times as heavy as 1`g`.
end.sound: Well done. 1 kg has the same weight as 1000 grams. This means that 1 kg is one thousand times as heavy as 1 gram.

hint.sound: 1 kg has the same weight as 1000 grams.

atoms.b: To convert a mass given in kilograms to grams, the measurement needs to be multiplied by ((10 100 ++1,000)).
